validation.original_seals: Coordinator validated sealed raw runs and scores before archival, as recorded in each archive-manifest.json. This aggregation independently checks published hashes and score/freeze/verifier bindings; it does not reconstruct original sealed workspaces from transformed public traces.

public_archive_transformations.reason: Avoid redistributing an inherited third-party skill body outside this repository; command/status/evidence locator retained.

limitations: All attempts retain case_compliant:false: filesystem reads were not jailed, inherited skills/tools remained available, network restrictions were not fully enforced, and effective sandbox write enforcement was not independently verified.
Metadata discovery, observed body reads, task correctness, runtime verifier results, and capability compliance are separate observations. not_observed is not proof of absence.
No matched control, randomized comparison, or repeated sample estimates skill uplift or general reliability. Revision reruns remain repeated attempts on the same cases.
Ten second-positive cases are authored but unexecuted in this archive.
Independent checks use local synthetic fixtures; no live cluster, broker, production database/provider, full OAuth flow, or MCP/A2A interoperability/conformance is established.
Native workflow and named-role behavior belongs to the separate workflow smoke evidence. These trials disable subagents and do not substitute for either host workflow smoke.
One inherited third-party skill output was omitted from a public trace. Original/published hashes and its event line are retained; original sealed artifacts remain outside this public archive.
